q_en: A and B working together can do 45% of the work in 9 days. A alone can do the work in 30 days. How many days will B alone take to do the same work?
e_en: Given: A = 30 days A + B = 45% of work in 9 days Calculation: A + B = 45% of work in 9 days A + B = 100% of work will be completed in (9/45) × 100 = 20 days So, (A + B) together can complete the work in 20 days A alone can do the work in 30 days. Suppose the total work is 60 units. A’s one day work = 60/30 = 2 units (A+ B)’s one day work = 60/20 = 3 units ∴ B’s one day work = (3 – 2) = 1 unit So, B alone can do the work in 60/1 = 60 days

q_en: A car moves a distance of 600 km with uniform speed. The number of hours taken for the journey is 2/3 of the number representing speed in km/h. The time taken to cover the distance is:
e_en: Given: The number of hours taken for the journey is 23" tabindex="0">2/3 of the speed Distance = 600 km Formula Used: Distance = Time × Speed Calculation: Suppose the number of hours for the journey is 2x and the speed is 3x. ⇒ Distance = Time × Speed ⇒ 600 = 2x × 3x ⇒ x² = 600/6 ⇒ x² = 100 ⇒ x = √100 ⇒ x = 10 ∴ Time taken to cover distance = 2x = 20 hours

q_en: If sinθ = 4/5, Find the value of sin3θ
e_en: Given: sinθ = 4/5 Formula Used: sin3θ = 3sinθ - 4sin³θ Calculation: sin3θ = 3sinθ - 4sin3θ ⇒ sin3θ = 3(4/5) - 4(4/5)³ ⇒ sin3θ = 12/5 - 256/125 ⇒ sin3θ = 44/125 ∴ The answer is 44/125.

q_en: The difference between a number and one-third of that number is 228. What is 20% of that number?
e_en: Given: The difference between a number and one-third of that number is 228. Calculation: Let number be x According to Question, x - (1/3)x = 228 ⇒ 2x/3 = 228 ⇒ x = 228 × 3/2 = 342 20% of the number = (20/100) × 342 = 68.4 ∴ 20% of the number is 68.4.

q_en: Find x if 2sin²x - 1 = 0

q_en: What is the area of a triangle whose sides measure 5 cm, 6 cm and 7 cm?
e_en: Given: The side of the triangle is 5, 6 and 7 cm Formula Used: Area of triangle = √[s(s - a)(s - b)(s-c)], where s = semiperimeter of the triangle Semiperimeter (S) = (1/2) × Sum of sides of the triangle Calculation: Semiperimeter (s) = (a + b + c)/2 = (5 + 6 + 7)/2 = 9 ⇒ Area of the triangle = √[s(s - a)(s - b)(s-c)] ⇒ √[9(9 - 5)(9 - 6)(9 - 7)] = √(9 × 4 × 3 × 2) = 14.69 cm² ∴ the area of the triangle is 14.69 cm2

q_en: The sum of two numbers is 59 and their product is 840. Find the sum of their squares.

q_en: The average age of 16 students in a college is 20. Out of them, the average age of 5 students is 20 and the average age of the other 10 students is 20.4. Find the age of the 16th college student.
e_en: Given: The average age of 16 student = 20 the average age of 5 student = 20 Formula used: Average = Sum of observation/No. of observation Calculation: Total age of 16 student = 16 × 20 = 320 ⇒ Total age of 5 student = 5 × 20 = 100 ⇒ Total age of 10 student = 10 × 20.4 = 204 ⇒ Let the age of 16th student be x ⇒ 320 = 100 + 204 + x ⇒ x = 16 ∴ The age of 16th college student is 16.

q_en: By selling an article for Rs 600, a shopkeeper makes a profit of 20%. At what price should he sell the article to incur a loss of 20% ?

q_en: Chord AB and diameter CD of a circle meet at the point P, outside the circle when it is produced, If PB = 8 cm, AB = 12 cm and distance of P from the centre of the circle is 18 cm, the radius (in cm) of the circle is closest to: [√41 = 6.4]

q_en: A car covers a distance of 48 km at a speed of 40 km/h and another 52 km with a speed of 65 km/h. What is the average speed of the car (in km/h) for the total distance covered?

q_en: Ashok completes a journey in 7 hours. He travels the first half of the journey at the speed of 24 km/h and the second half of it at the speed of 32 km/h. The total distance of the journey is:
e_en: Given: Total time of journey = 7 hrs Speed of Ashok in first half = 24 km/h Speed of Ashok in second half = 32 km/h Formula used: Distance = speed × time Calculation: Let total distance be 2x Time₁ = Distance/speed ⇒ x/24 hrs Time₂ = Distance/speed ⇒ x/32 hrs Total time = (Time₁ + Time₂) ⇒ 7 = (x/24 + x/32) ⇒ 7 = (4x + 3x)/96 ⇒ 7 = (7x/96) ⇒ x = 96 km Total distance = 2x ⇒ (2 × 96) ⇒ 192 km ∴ Total distance covered by Ashok is 192 km

q_en: If x + y = 5 and x² + y² = 17 then the value of 〖(x-y)〗² is equal to:
e_en: Given: ⇒ x + y = 5 ⇒ x2 + y2 = 17 Formula: ⇒ (a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab ⇒ (a - b)2 = a2 + b2 - 2ab Calculation: ⇒ (x + y)² = x² + y² + 2xy ⇒ 2xy = 25 - 17 = 8 Then, (x - y)² = x² + y² - 2xy = 17 - 8 = 9 ∴ (x - y)2 = 9

q_en: The sides AB and AC of a ∆ABC are produced up to points D and E. The bisectors of the exterior angles to formed. intersect each other at point I if ∠ACB is 66⁰ and ∠ABC is 440, then what is the measure (in degrees) of ∠BIC?
e_en: Given: ∠ACB = 66º and ∠ABC = 44º Calculation: ∠ABC + ∠CBD = 180 ....(Linear angles) ∠CBD = 180º - 44º = 136º Using angle bisector, ∠CBI = ∠IBD = 136º/2 = 68º ∠ACB + ∠BCE = 180º ....(Linear angles) ∠BCE = 180º - 66º = 114º Using angle bisector, ∠BCI = ∠ICE = 114º/2 ∠BCI = 57º In ΔBCI, ∠BCI + ∠CBI + ∠BIC = 180º ∠BIC = 180º - 68º - 57º = 55º ∴ ∠BIC = 55º

q_en: When an integer n is divided by 6, the remainder is 5. What is the remainder if 9n is divided by 6?
e_en: Given: When an integer n is divided by 6, the remainder is 5 Formula: Number = quotient × Divisor + remainder Calculation: n = quotient × 6 + 5 9n = 9(6 × quotient + 5) = 9 × 6 × quotient + 5 × 9 = 9 × 6 × quotient + 7 × 6 + 3 = 6(9quotient + 7) + 3 ∴ 3 is the remainder if 9n is divided by 6.

q_en: If the simple interest for 9 years be equal to 45% of the principal, then the rate of interest per annum is equal to:

q_en:
Solve for x?
sin²x - 4 sin x + 3 = 0, 0 ≤ x ≤ π/2
e_en: Given: sin²x - 4 sin x + 3 = 0 Calculation: Let sinx = k ⇒ k² - 4k + 3 = 0 ⇒ k² - 3k - k + 3 = 0 ⇒ k(k - 3) - 1(k - 3) = 0 ⇒ (k - 1)(k - 3) = 0 k = 1 or k = 3 Then, ⇒ sin x = 1 ⇒ x = sin ⁻¹(1) ∴ x = π/2

q_en: Two person P and Q are 844 m apart. The both start cycling simultaneously in the same direction with speeds of 12 m/s and 8 m/s, respectively, In how much time will P overtake Q?

q_en: A can complete a piece of work in 7 days and B can complete the same work in 12 days. A and B worked together for 3 days. C alone completed the remaining work in 9 days will C take to complete the same work entirely?
e_en: Given: A's 1 day's work = 1/7 B's 1 day's work = 1/12 Calculation: (A + B)'s 1 day's work = 1/7 + 1/12 = 19/84 (A + B)'s 3 days work = 3 × 19/84 = 19/28 Remaining work = 1 - 19/28 = 9/28 Number of days in which C alone can complete work = 28/9 × 9 = 28 days ∴ C alone can complete work in 28 days.

q_en: if tanθ + cotθ = 4, then the ratio of 3(tan²θ + cot²θ) to (2cosec²θ sec²θ - 4) will be:

New rate of interest = 8.4 + 2.6 = 11% per annum Maturity amount in 3 years = 4000 × 3 × 11/100 + 4000 = Rs. 5320 ∴ Revised maturity amount in 3 years is Rs. 5320.

q_en: A man sells two articles for Rs. 620 each, one at a profit of 24% and the other at a loss of 24%. What is his loss/profit percent in the whole transaction?

q_en: A bicycle wheel has a radius of 42 cm. It makes 40 revolutions in 25 seconds. What is its speed (in km/h, up to one decimal place)?

q_en: A kite is flying at the height of 138 m above the ground. It is attached to a string inclined at 45° to the horizontal. What is the approximate length (in m) of the string?
e_en: Given: Height at which kite flying = 138m Calculation: Triangle is formed with the height at which the kite flies as the height of the triangle, the Length of string as one side of the triangle, and the horizontal as the base of the triangle. The triangle is 45 - 45 - 90 triangle. ⇒ sin 45 = (height at which kite fly)/(Length of string) ⇒ 1/√2 = 138m/length of string ⇒ length of sting = 195.16 ≈ 195m ∴ The approximate length of the string is 195m.

q_en: If ( x + (2)/(x) ) = 7, then what is the value of ( 2x² + (8)/(x²) ) ?
e_en: Given: ⇒ (x + 2/x) = 7 Formula: (a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab Calculation: According to the question, ⇒(x + 2/x) = 7 Squaring on both sides of the equation, we get ⇒(x + 2/x)2 = 7² Using the formula: (a + b)2 = a2 + b2 + 2ab ⇒ x2 + 4/x2 + 2 × x × 2/x = 49 ⇒x² + 4/x² + 4 = 49 ⇒ x² + 4/x² = 49 - 4 ⇒ x2 + 4/x2 = 45 Multiplying by 2 on both sides of the equation, we get ⇒ 2 × (x2 + 4/x²) = 45 × 2 ⇒ 2x² + 8/x² = 90 ∴ The value of (2x² + 8/x²) is 90.

q_en: The perimeter of an isosceles triangle is 91 cm and its base is 1 1/4 times each of its equal sides. What is the length (in cm) of its base?
e_en: Given: Perimeter of an isosceles triangle = 91cm Formula: Perimeter of an isosceles triangle = 2 × equal side + unequal side Calculation: ⇒ Base = 5/4 × equal side Then, ⇒ 91 = 2 × equal side + 5/4 × equal side ⇒ 13/4 × equal side = 91 ⇒ Equal side = 28 cm ⇒ Base = 5/4 × 28 = 35 cm ∴ Length of base is 35cm.

q_en: A man cycles from P to Q, a distance of 30 km, in 2 hours 48 minutes. The road from P is a level road for 18 km and then it is uphill to Q. The man’s average speed on the level road is 15 km/h. What is his average uphill speed (in km/h)?
e_en: Given: Distance between P and Q = 30km Formula: Average speed = total distance/total time Calculation: Time taken by A = 2 hr + 48 min = 2 + 48/60 = 14/5 = 2.8 hours Distance of level road = 18km Time taken to travel level road = 18/15 = 1.2 hours Time taken to travel uphill road = 2.8 - 1.2 = 1.6 hours Distance of uphill road = 30 - 18 = 12 km Speed to travel uphill road = 12/1.6 = 7.5 kmph ∴ Average uphill road speed is 7.5kmph.

q_en: A solid metallic right circular cylinder has diameter 32 cm and height 9 cm. It is melted and recast into a solid sphere. What is the radius (in cm) of the sphere?

q_en: A mobile phone is available for Rs. 79,860 by cash payment or by paying cash of Rs. 60,000 as down payment and the remaining amount in three equal annual instalments. If the shopkeeper charges interest at the rate of 10% per annum compounded annually, then the amount of each instalment (in Rs) will be:
e_en: Given: Down payment = Rs.60000 Formula: Let P = Principal, R = Rate of interest and N = time Compound interest = P(1 + R/100)ⁿ - P Calculation: Amount to be paid in installments = 79860 - 60000 = Rs.19860 Let each installment be of Rs.a ⇒ 19860 = a/(1 + 10/100) + a/(1 + 10/100)² + a/(1 + 10/100)³ ⇒ a = 19860 × 1331/3310 ⇒ a = 7986 ∴ Amount of each installment is Rs.7986.

q_en: The marked price of an article is Rs. 300. It is sold for Rs. 177.84 after giving three successive discounts of 20%, x% and 5%. What is value of x ?
e_en: Given: Marked price = Rs.300 Three discounts = 20%, x% and 5% Selling price = Rs.177.84 Calculation: Discounted price = 300 - 177.84 = Rs.122.16 Single equivalent discount = 100 - 100 × (100 - 20)/100 × (100 - x)/100 × (100 - 5)/100 = 100 - 100 × 80/100 × (100 - x)/100 × 95/100 = 100 - 76 + 0.76x = 24 + 0.76x Then, ⇒ 122.16 = 300 × (24 + 0.76x)/100 ⇒ 0.76x = 16.72 ⇒ x = 22 ∴ The value of x is 22.

q_en: Varun and Madhur invested Rs. 25,000 each in different schemes. Varun earned simple interest at 11% per annum, whereas Madhur earned compound interest at 10% per annum compounded annually. Who received more interest after 2 years and how much?
e_en: Given: Rate of interest = 11% Formula: Let P = Principal, R = rate of interest and N = time Simple interest = PNR/100 Compound interest = P(1 + R/100)ⁿ - P Calculation: SI earned by Varun = (25000 × 2 × 11)/100 = Rs.5500 Equivalent rate of interest for Madhur = 10 + 10 + (10 × 10)/100 = 21% Compound interest for Madhur = 21% of 25000 = (25000 × 21)/100 ⇒ Rs. 5250 Difference between interests = 5500 - 5250 = Rs.250 ∴ Varun earned Rs.250 more interest than Madhur.

q_en: The average daily income of Shyam Lal during the month of February 2020 was Rs. 560. The average income for the first 16 days was Rs. 590 and for the last 16 days it was Rs. 500. What was his average income for 14th 15th and 16th February?
e_en: Given: Average daily income for February month = Rs.560 Calculation: 2020 is a leap year, so number of days in February is 29. Total daily income of Shyam lal = 29 × 560 = Rs.16240 Total daily income for first 16 days = 16 × 590 = Rs.9440 Total daily income for last 16 days = 16 × 500 = Rs.8000 Total income for 14th, 15th and 16th days = 17440 - 16240 = Rs.1200 ∴ His average income for 14th 15th and 16th February = 1200/3 = Rs.400

q_en: ABC is a right-angled triangle, right-angled at B. D is a point on AC such that AD = 12 cm and CD = 16 cm. If BD bisects ∠ABC , then the perimeter of ΔABC will be:

Using pythagoras theorem, ⇒ AC² = AB² + BC² ⇒ AC = 5a ⇒ AD + DC = AC ⇒ AC = 12 + 16 = 28 ⇒ 28 = 5a ⇒ a = 5.6 ∴ Perimeter of ΔABC = 3a + 4a + 5a = 12a = 67.2 cm

q_en: A, B and C can independently complete the same task in 4, 6 and 12 days, respectively. In how many days will they be able to complete the same task if they work together?
e_en: Given: A can do in 4 days B can do in 6 days C can do in 12 days Concept used: One day work of x = 1/b Here b = time to taken to complete the work Calculation: A's one day work = 1/4 B's one day work = 1/6 C's one day work = 1/12 A + B + C one work = 1/4 + 1/6 + 1/12 ⇒ (3 + 2 + 1)/12 ⇒ 6/12 ⇒ 1/2 ⇒ Time = 2 days ∴ They will complete in 2 days

q_en: The lengths of three sides of a triangle are in the ratio 3 ∶ 4 ∶ 5. Among three sides, the difference between the largest side and the smallest side of this triangle is 3.6 cm. The area (in cm?) of the triangle is:
e_en: Given: Ratio of sides of the triangle = 3 : 4 : 5 Formula used: 1/2 × base × height Calculation: Let sides are 3x, 4x, and 5x According to the question, 5x - 3x = 3.6 ⇒ 2x = 3.6 ⇒ x = 1.8 cm We know 3, 4, 5 are Pythagorean triplets So, Area = 1/2 × 3x × 4x ⇒ 1/2 × 5.4 × 7.2 ⇒ 19.44 cm² ∴ The area of the trinagle is 19.44 cm²

q_en: The inner and outer radii of two concentric circles are 6.7 cm and 9.5 cm, respectively. What is the difference between their circumferences (in cm) ? Take π = 22/7
e_en: Given: Inner radius of concentric circles = 6.7cm Outer radius of concentric circles = 9.5 cm Formula: Circumference of circle = 2πr Calculation: Circumference of small circle = π × 2 × 6.7 = 13.4π Circumference of big circle = π × 2 × 9.5 = 19π ∴ Difference between their circumference = (19 - 13.4)π = 5.6 × 22/7 = 17.6 cm

q_en: One-quarter of a circular pizza of diameter 28 cm was removed from the whole pizza. What is the perimeter (in cm) of the remaining pizza? (Take π = 22/7)

q_en: By selling an article for Rs. 1,170, Elisa suffers as much loss as she would have gained by selling it at a profit of 22%. If she sells it for Rs. 1,450, then her profit/loss per cent (correct up to one decimal place) is:

Loss = a - 1170 Profit = a - 1170 But, ⇒ 22 = (SP - a)/a × 100 ⇒ 22a = 100SP - 100a ⇒ 122a = 100SP Then, ⇒ a - 1170 = SP - a ⇒ SP = 2a - 1170 Solving, SP = Rs.1830 Then, CP = a = Rs.1500 ∴ New loss % = (1500 - 1450)/1500 × 100 = 3.33%

q_en: A boat can travel with a speed of 19 km/h in still water. If the speed of the stream is 3 km/h, then what will be the total time (in hours) taken by the boat to go 88 km downstream and 24 km upstream?
e_en: Given: Speed of boat in still water = 19kmph Speed of stream = 3kmph Formula: Downstream speed = Speed of boat in still water + Speed of stream Upstream speed = Speed of boat in still water - Speed of stream Calculation: Downstream speed = 19 + 3 = 22 kmph Upstream speed = 19 - 3 = 16kmph Required time = 88/22 + 24/16 = 4 + 3/2 = 5.5 ∴ total time (in hours) taken by the boat to go 88 km downstream and 24 km upstream is 5.5 hours.

q_en: A solid metallic hemisphere of radius 6.3 cm is melted and recast into a right circular cylinder of radius 9 cm. What is the height (in cm, correct to one decimal place) of the cylinder?
e_en: Given: Radius of hemisphere = 6.3 cm Radius of cylinder = 9 cm Formula: Volume of hemisphere = 2/3 × πr³ Volume of cylinder = πr²h Calculation: Volume of hemisphere = 2/3 × π × (6.3)³ Volume of cylinder = πh × (9)² Then, ⇒ 2π/3 × 6.3³ = πh × 9² ⇒ h = 2.058 ⇒ h = 2.1 cm(nearest value) ∴ Height of cylinder is 2.1cm

q_en: Tap P can fill a cistern in 6 hours and tap Q can empty the full cistern in 10 hours. If both taps P and Q are kept open simultaneously, then in how many hours will the empty cistern be completely full ?

q_en: A man invests Rs. 7,000 at 8% per annum simple interest for 2 years and Rs. 10,000 at compound interest at the same rate for the same period, compounded annually. What will be the total interest and the total amount (in Rs.) respectively, on maturity?
e_en: Given: Sum = Rs.7000 Rate of interest = 8% Time = 2 years Formula: Let P = Principal, R = rate of interest and N = time SI = PNR/100 CI = P(1 + R/100)² - P Calculation: SI = 7000 × 8 × 2/100 = Rs.1120 Amount after SI = 7000 + 1120 = Rs.8120 CI = 10000(1 + 8/100)² - 10000 = Rs.1664 Amount after CI = 10000 + 1664 = Rs.11664 ∴ Total amount after maturity = 8120 + 11664 = Rs.19784 Total interest after 2 years = 1120 + 1664 = Rs.2784

q_en: PQRS is a cyclic quadrilateral with QR as the diameter of the circle. If ∠SQR = 24°, then what will be the measure of ∠QPS?
e_en: Given: ∠SQR = 24° Calculation: ∠QSR = 90° (Angle inscribed in a semicircle) ⇒ ∠SQR + ∠QSR + ∠QRS = 180° [sum of interior angles of a triangle is 180°] ⇒ 24° + 90° + ∠QRS = 180° ⇒ 114° + ∠QRS = 180° ⇒ ∠QRS = (180° – 114°) ⇒ ∠QRS = 66° Now, ∠QPS + ∠QRS = 180° [sum of pair of opposite sides of cyclic quadrilateral is 180°] ⇒ ∠QPS + 66° = 180° ⇒ ∠QPS = (180° – 66°) ⇒ ∠QPS = 114° ∴ The required value of ∠QPS is 114°

q_en: P and Q can complete a work in 9 days and 15 days, respectively. If they work together for three days, then in how many days will the remaining work be completed by Q alone?

q_en: If x + y + z = 13, x² + y² + z² = 91 and xz = y², then the difference between z and x is:
e_en: Given: x + y + z = 13 x2 + y2 + z2 = 91 xz = y2 Concept used: (a + b + c)² = a² + b² + c² + 2 (ab + bc + ca) (a - b)² = a² - 2ab + b² Calculation: x + y + z = 13 ⇒ (x + y + z)² = 13² ⇒ x2 + y2 + z2 + 2(xy + yz + xz) = 169 ⇒ (xy + yz + xz) = 39 ⇒ xy + yz + y² = 39 ⇒ y(x + y + z) = 39 ⇒ y = 3 ⇒ y² = 9 ⇒ xz = 9 ⇒ 3xz = 27 So, x2 + y2 + z2 = 91 ⇒ x2 + xz - 3xz + z2 = 91 - 27 ⇒ x2 - 2xz + z2 = 64 ⇒ (z - x)² = 64 ⇒ (z - x) = 8 ∴ The difference between z and x is 8.

q_en: In a class of 80 students (boys and girls) there are 60% girls. The average weight of the boys is 58 kg and that of the girls is 52 kg. What is the average weight (in kg) of the whole class?
e_en: Given: Total students = 80 60% are girls The average weight of boys is 58 kg and the average weight of girls is 52 kg. Concept Used: Average weight = (Sum of the weight of all the students/Total no. of students) Calculation: Number of girls = 80 × (60/100) = 48 Number of boys = (80 - 48) = 32 Now average weight of whole class = ((32 × 58) + (48 × 52))/80 = 4352/80 = 54.4 ∴ The average weight (in kg) of the whole class will be 54.4.

q_en: Ravi can row a boat in still water at the speed of 14 km/h. If a river is flowing at the sped of 2 km/h and Ravi takes 3 hours to cover a certain distance upstream, then how much time will he take to cover the same distance downstream?

On the other hand, while going downstream, to take the effective speed, the difference between the speed of the boat and the flow of the river is considered.

q_en: The average weight of 3 persons A, B and C is 60 kg. When D joins the group, the average weight becomes 65 kg. When another person E whose weight is 3 kg less than that of D replaces A, the average weight of B, C, D and E becomes 67 kg. What is the weight of A?

E whose weight is 3 kg less than that of D replaces A, the average weight of B, C, D, and E becomes 67 kg. Concept used: Total = Average × Number of entities Calculation: So, the weight of D = (65 × 4) - (60 × 3) = 80kg Then, the weight of E = 80 - 3 = 77kg According to the question, 77 + (60 × 3 - A) + 80 = 67 × 4 ⇒ A = 69 ∴ The weight of A is 69kg.

q_en: A customer availed a 10% discount on the purchase of a table and paid Rs. 4,950 for it. How much money would he have saved if he had bargained to get 12% discount?
e_en: Given: Discount % = 10 Cost price = RS. 4950 Formula used: Cost Price = Market Price - Discount Calculation: let the market price is Rs.x so, 4950 = x - 10% of x ⇒ 4950 = 90x/100 ⇒ x = (4950 × 100)/90 ⇒ x = 5500 if discount rate is 12% Then, cost price = 5500 - 12% of 5500 ⇒ 5500 - 660 ⇒ Rs. 4840 Money gained at 12% discount = RS.(4950 - 4840) ⇒ Rs. 110 ∴ Customer would save Rs. 110, if he had bargained to get 12% discount.

q_en: What is the sum of all the possible values of k for which a seven-digit number 23k567k is divisible by 3?
e_en: Given: A seven-digit number 23k567k is divisible by 3 Concept used: Divisibility rule of 3 → If the sum of all digits of a number is divisible by 3 Calculation: 2 + 3 + k + 5 + 6 + 7 + k = 23 + 2k Now, 23 + 2k is divisible by 3 So, the Nearest numbers which is divisible by 3 = 24, 27, 30, 33, 36, 39 Now, 2k ≠ 1, 7, 13 k ≤ 9 So, possible values of 2k = 4, 10, 16 So, the sum of all the values of 2k = 30 So, k = 15 ∴ The required answer is 15

q_en: In any triangle, if the angles are in the ratio 1 : 2 : 3, then what will be the ratio of the side opposite to them?
e_en: Given: The ratio of angles = 1 : 2 : 3 Concept used: Sine rule = a/sinA = b/sinB = c/sinC Calculation: Let A = x, B = 2x and C = 3x ⇒ ∠A + ∠B + ∠C = 180° [angle sum property] ⇒ x + 2x + 3x = 180° ⇒ 6x = 180° ⇒ x = 30° ⇒ ∠A = 30°, ∠B = 60° and ∠C = 90° Now, As we know that, ⇒ a/sin30° = b/sin60° = c/sin90° ⇒ a/1/2 = b/√3/2 = c/1 ⇒ a = 1, b = √3 and c = 2 So, a : b : c = 1 : √3 : 2 ∴ The required ratio is 1 : √3 : 2

q_en: A solid metallic sphere of radius 10 cm is melted and recast into spheres of radius 2 cm each. How many such spheres can be made?

q_en: When a number is divided by 3, the remainder is 2. Again, when the quotient is divided by 7, the remainder is 5. What will be the remainder when the original number is divided by 21?
e_en: Concept used: Number = Quotient × Divisor + Remainder # In such questions, we start from last Calculation: Let last quotient be 'x' ⇒ Last number = 7x + 5 ∴ First number = 3 × (7x + 5) + 2 = 21x + 17 Now, when 21x + 17 is divided by 21 ⇒ Remainder = 17

q_en: If 3 sin² A + 4 cos² A - 3 = 0, then the value of cot A (where 0 ≤ A ≤ 90°) is:

q_en: If a² + b² + c² + 48 = 8(a + b + c), then what is the value of sqrt[3]{a³-b³+c³} ?
e_en: Given: a2 + b2 + c2 + 48 = 8(a + b + c) Calculation: a2 + b2 + c2 + 48 = 8(a + b + c) ⇒ a2 - 8a + 16 + b2 - 8b + 16 + c2 - 8c + 16 = 0 ⇒ (a - 4)² + (b - 4)2 + (c - 4)2 = 0 Now, sum of squares = 0 ⇒ each term is = 0 ∴ a - 4 = 0 , b - 4 = 0 and c - 4 = 0 ⇒ a = b = c = 4 ∴ sqrt[3]{a³-b³+c³} = sqrt[3]{4³-4³+4³} = sqrt[3]{4³} = 4

q_en: A bus covered 360 km in 6 hours. If it travels at one-fourth of its usual speed, then how much more time will it take to cover the same distance?

e_en: Given: Perimeter = 86 cm Ratio of Area and its breadth = 9 : 1 Formula used: Area of rectangle = Length × Breadth Perimeter of rectangle = 2 (Length + Breadth) Calculation: Area ÷ Breadth = 9 : 1 ⇒ (L × B) ÷ B = 9 ÷ 1 ⇒ L = 9 cm Now, Perimeter of rectangle = 2 (Length + Breadth) ⇒ 86 = 2(9 + Breadth) ⇒ 9 + Breadth = 43 ⇒ Breadth = 34 cm ∴ Breadth of rectangle is 34 cm

q_en: In how much time will a sum of Rs.5,000 invested at the rate of 15%, simple interest per annum amount to Rs.6,500?
e_en: Given: Principal = Rs. 5000 Rate of interest = 15% Amount = Rs. 6500 Formula used: Interest = Amount – Principal Interest = PRT/100 Calculation: Interest = Rs. (6500 - 5000) ⇒ Rs. 1500 Now, (5000 × 15 × T)/100 = 1500 ⇒ 750T = 1500 ⇒ T = 2 years ∴ Required time is 2 years

q_en: If 3a - b = 1 and ab = 4, then the value of (9a² - b²) is:
e_en: Given: 3a – b = 1 and ab = 4 Formula used: (a – b)² = a² + b² – 2ab Calculation: 3a – b = 1 squaring both sides (3a)² + (b)² – 2 × 3a × b = (1)² ⇒ 9a² + b² – 6ab = 1 Adding 12ab both sides, we get ⇒ 9a2 + b2 – 6ab + 12ab = 1 + 12ab ⇒ 9a² + b² + 6ab = 1 + 12ab ⇒ (3a + b)² = 1 + 12ab ⇒ (3a + b)² = 1 + 12 × 4 ⇒ (3a + b)² = 1 + 48 ⇒ (3a + b)² = 49 ⇒ (3a + b)² = 7² ⇒ (3a + b) = 7 Now, (9a2 - b2) = (3a - b)(3a + b) = 1 × 7 = 7 ∴ The required value is 7

Calculation: Let CD = P cm. So, BD = (P - 2) cm According to the question, P + P - 2 = 10 ⇒ P = 6 So, CD = 6 cm and BD = 4 cm. q_en: If 5 tan A = 12, then what is the value of (13 sin A + 20 tan A)/(15 tan A - 13 cos A), where A is an acute angle?

If both Shyamal and Radha start together, then the distance covered by Shyamal in 8 min = 1000/10×8=800 m Now, Shyamal covers less distance than Radha. Radha will beat Shyamal by = 1000 – 800 = 200 m. Hence, Radha beat Shyamal by the distance of 200 m.

q_en: Giri bought an old machine for ₹2,000 and spent ₹500 on its repair. He sold it for ₹4,000. His profit percentage is:
e_en: Given: Price at which machine was bought = Rs 2,000 Repairment cost = Rs 500 The selling price of the machine = Rs 4,000 Concept Used: Profit Percentage = (Profit)/(CP)times 100 Calculation: Bought Price of machine = Rs 2,000 Repairment cost = Rs 500 Cost Price of Machine = 2000 + 500 = Rs 2,500 Profit = Selling Price – Cost Price = 4000 – 2500 Profit = Rs 1500 Now, Profit Percentage = 1500/2500×100=60%. Hence, the profit percentage made by Giri on this machine is 60%.

q_en: If the length of a cuboid is 20 m, breadth is 5 m and height is 4 m, then find the length of diagonal of the cuboid.
e_en: Given: Length of cuboid = 20 m Breadth of cuboid = 5 m Height of cuboid = 4 m Formula Used: Diagonal of cuboid = sqrt {l²+b²+h²} Calculation: ⇒ sqrt {20²+5²+4²} ⇒ sqrt {400+25+16}=sqrt {441} ⇒ 21 m ∴ the length of the diagonal of the cuboid is 21 m.

q_en: If x = 32, y = 33 and z = 35, then evaluate the expression x³ + y³ + z³ – 3xyz.
e_en: Given: x = 32 y = 33 z = 35 Concept Used: x³ + y³ + z³ – 3xyz = 1/2 (x + y + z)[(x – y)² + (y – z)² + (z – x)²] Calculation: Putting the values in the formula, ⇒ 1/2 (32 + 33 + 35)[(32 – 33)2 + (33 – 35)2 + (35 – 32)2] ⇒ 1/2 × 100 × (1 + 4 + 9) ⇒ 50 × 14 ⇒ 700 ∴ the value of the given expression is 700.

q_en: In what ratio must a shopkeeper mix two types of rice worth ₹60 per kg and ₹80 per kg, so that the average cost of the mixture is ₹75 per kg?
e_en: Given: Price of the first type of rice = Rs 80 per kg Price of the second type of rice = Rs 60 per kg The average cost of mixture = Rs 75 per kg Concept Used: Rule of allegation = (Rice 1 Cost – Average) ÷ (Average – Rice 2 Cost) Calculation: The ratio for the mixing of rice = (80-75)/(75-60) The ratio for the mixing of rice = 5/15=1/3=1:3 Hence, the ratio in which a shopkeeper should mix two types of rice is 1 : 3

q_en: A can do 1/5 of the work in 3 days and B can do 1/4 of the work in 7.5 days . Working together, A and B can do 4/5 of the same work in:
e_en: Given: Number of days taken by A to complete 1/5 of the work = 3 days Number of days taken by B to complete 1/4 of the work = 7.5 days Concept Used: Rate of work = 1 / Time taken Calculation: Time taken by A to complete the work = 1/5times1/3 = 1/15 Time taken by B to complete the work = 1/4times(1)/(7.5) = 1/30 Time taken to complete the whole work together = 1/15+1/30=1/10 = 10 days According to the question, Time taken to complete 4/5 of the work together = 4/5×10=8 days.

e_en: Given: The ratio of three numbers A, B and C = 15 : 21 : 27 Concept Used: The ratio of difference = Difference between A and B ÷ Difference between B and C Calculation: Let the numbers A, B and C be 15x, 21x and 27x respectively. q_en: What will be a single equivalent discount for successive discounts of 20%, 40% and 75% on the marked price of an item?

Formula: Successive discount = X + Y -(XY)/(100) Where, X = First discount Y = Second discount Calculation: Successive discount = X+Y-(XY)/(100) 20+40-((20×40))/(100) = 52% Now, again Successive discount = X+Y-(XY)/(100) ⇒ X = 52%, Y = 75% ⇒ 52+75-((52×75))/(100) ⇒ 127-39 ⇒ 88 ∴ The single equivalent discount is 88%.

q_en: A and B together can do a piece of work in 12 days, while A alone can complete the same work in 18 days. How long will B alone take to complete the work?
e_en: Given: A and B together can do a piece of work in 12 days A alone can complete the same work in 18 days Calculations: According to the question, One day work of A = 1/18 units One day Work of A + B = 1/12 units One day work of B = (One day Work of A + B) - (One day Work of A) ⇒ B = 1/12 - 1/18 ⇒ B = (3 - 2)/ 36 ⇒ B = 1/36 = 36 days ∴ B alone can complete the same work in 36 days.

q_en: A man can row 5 km/h in still water. If the speed of the current is 2.5 km/h, it takes 4 hours more in upstream than in the downstream for the same distance. The distance is:
e_en: Given: Speed in still water = 5km/h Speed of upstream = 5km/h - Current speed = 5 - 2.5 = 2.5km/h Time in upstream = 4 h + Time in Downstream Concept used: Distance = Speed × Time Calculations: According to the question, Distance for Upstream = Distance for downstream ⇒ 2.5 (4 + T) = 7.5T ⇒ 10 + 2.5T = 7.5T ⇒ 5T = 10 ⇒ T = 10/5 = 2 h Now substituting the value of T in Downstream then ⇒ D = 7.5 × 2 = 15km ∴ The distance is 15 km.

q_en: RA and RB are two tangents from a common point ‘R’ outside the circle with centre ‘O’, having a radius of 6 cm. If ∠ARB = 70°, find the measure of the angle AOB.

Now, this is in the form of a² - b² -2.a.b. ⇒ ( a- (1)/(a))² + (b -(1)/(b))² = 0. Hence, ( a - (1)/(a))² = 0. and ( b -(1)/(b))² = 0.

q_en: A group of 36 students has an average present age of 14 years. When the age of the teacher is included, the average age rises by one. Calculate the teacher's age (in years).
e_en: GIVEN: Average of age of 36 students = 14 years Average of teacher and students = 15 years FORMULA USED: Average = sum of values/ number of values CALCULATION: ⇒ Sum of students / 36 = 14 ⇒ sum of age of students = ( 36 × 14 ) = 504. ⇒ ( sum of students + teacher) /37 = 15 ⇒ sum of age of students and teacher = ( 37× 15) = 555 ⇒ Age of teacher = ( sum of age of students and teacher) - sum of age of student = (555- 504) = 51 years. Hence, the teacher is 51 year old.

q_en: If ABC is a triangle in which DE ‖ BC and AD ∶ DB = 9 ∶ 8, then DE ∶ BC is _________.
e_en: GIVEN: In triangle ABC, DE// BC AD/.DB = 9/8 CONCEPT USED: Basic Proportionality Theorem (BPT) = If line DE is parallel to side BC of triangle ABC that intersects the other sides into two points, line DE divides AB and AC in proportion. AD/AB = AE/AC = DE/BC CALCULATION: In triangle ABC, AD/DB = 9/8 ⇒ AD/AB = DE/BC ⇒ 9/(9+8) = DE/BC ⇒ 9/17 = DE/BC Hence, DE :BC = 9:17.

q_en: A shopkeeper mixes two qualities of rice, which cost him ₹40 per kg and ₹47.50 per kg respectively, in such a way that he has 15 kg of the blended rice costing him a total of ₹645. What is the weight (in kg) of the rice that cost him ₹47.50 per kg?

q_en: A container is normally filled in 5 hours. However, it takes 6 hours when there is a leak at the bottom. If the container is full, in what time would the leak empty it, if no water is allowed into the container during that period?

q_en: When two numbers are separately divided by 44, the remainders are 11 and 38, respectively. If the sum of the two numbers is divided by 44, then the remainder will be:

q_en: What is the volume of a right circular cylinder whose curved surface area is 12 π cm² and the circumference of its base is 4 π cm?
e_en: Given: The curved surface area of right circular cylinder = 12 π cm². Circumference = 4 π cm2. Formula Used: Curved surface area = 2 × πrh where, h = height of the cylinder, and r = radius of the cylinder. Circumference = 2 × πr The volume of the cylinder = πr²h CALCULATION: Circumference = 4 × π ⇒ 2 × πr = 4 × π ⇒ r = 2 cm Curved surface area = 12 × π ⇒ 2 × πrh = 12 × π ⇒ 2 × 2 × h = 12 ⇒ h = 3 cm.

Now, C.I. for 2 years = Rs300. Difference between C.I. and S.I. for 2 years = ( 300 -250) = Rs50. Hence, Required Rate of Interest =( 50/ 125 ) × 100 = 40%.

Concept Used: Cost Price = Selling Price × 100/(100 + Profit%) Calculation: Let the CP of a pen = Rs. x Profit = 5% SP = Rs. 1.05x According to question 1.05x + 36 = 1.14x 1.14x - 1.05x = 36 .09x = 36 x = Rs. 400 ∴ CP of a pen = Rs. 400 ∴ Option D is the correct answer.

q_en: ABCD is a cyclic quadrilateral in which angle B is opposite to angle D. If ∠B = x + 10 degree and ∠D = 2x + 35 degree, then what is the value of x?
e_en: Given: ABCD is a cyclic quadrilateral. ∠B is opposite to ∠D. ∠B and ∠D are x + 10 and 2x + 35 respectively. Concept Used: In a cyclic quadrilateral, the sum of a pair of opposite angles is 180 degrees. Calculation: Since angle B and angle D are opposite to each other, we have: ∠B + ∠D = 180° x + 10 + 2x + 35 = 180 Solving for x: ⇒ 3x + 45 = 180 ⇒ 3x = 135 ⇒ x = 45 So, the value of x is 45°. ∴ Option D is the correct answer.

q_en: If sin theta=5/13, then what is the value of (cos² theta-sin² theta)/(2cos theta.sin theta)?
e_en: Given: sin θ=5/13 Concept Used: cos θ = √(1 - sin² θ) Calculation: sin θ = 5/13 ⇒ cos θ = √(1 - (5/13)²) ⇒ cos θ = √(169 - 25)/169 ⇒ cos θ = √(144/169) ⇒ cos θ = 12/13 Put the values in (cos² theta-sin² theta)/(2cos theta.sin theta) ⇒ ((12/13)² -(5/13)²)/(2times 12/13 times 5/13) ⇒ (119/169)/(120/169) ⇒ 119/120 ∴ Option D is the correct answer.

q_en: The perimeter of an isosceles triangle is 91 cm. If one of the equal sides measures 28 cm, then what is the value of the other non-equal side?
e_en: Given: The perimeter of an isosceles triangle = 91 cm. One of the equal sides measures 28 cm. Concept used: An isosceles triangle two angles will also be the same in front of the equal sides. Formula used: P = (2a + b) Where, p = perimeter a = side and b = another side Calculation: Let the length of the equal sides be x P = (2a + b) ⇒ 91 = 2 × 28 + b ⇒ (91 – 56) = b ⇒ 35 = b ∴ The length of the non-equal side is 35 cm. ∴ Option D is the correct answer.

q_en: Vikram allows two successive discounts of 20% and 10% on the marked price of a book, which is equal to a single discount of Rs. 252. Then how much profit will Vikram get, on that book, if the cost price is Rs. 600?
e_en: Given: Two successive discounts 20% and 10%. Equivalent discount = Rs. 252 Cost price(CP) = Rs. 600 Formula used: Equivalent discount = R% + L% - R × L/100 Profit = SP - CP SP = Market price(MRP) - Discount Calculation: Equivalent discount of (20% and 10%) = 20% + 10% - 20 × 10/100 ⇒ 28% Now, 28% = 252 ⇒ 1% = 252/28 = 9 MPR(100%) = 9 × 100 = 900 ∴ SP = 900 - 252 = Rs. 648 Since, CP = Rs. 600 ∴ Profit = 648 - 600 = Rs. 48 ∴ Option C is the correct answer.

q_en: In how much time will a sum of Rs. 12500 amounts to Rs. 20000 at the rate of 8 percent per annum at simple interest?
e_en: Given: Principal (P) = Rs. 12500 Final Amount (A) = Rs. 20000 Rate of interest (r) = 8% per annum Concept: Simple Interest = (Principal × Rate × Time)/100. We rearrange this formula to solve for Time. Calculation: Simple Interest = Final Amount - Principal ⇒ Rs. 20000 - Rs. 12500 = Rs. 7500 Time = (Simple Interest × 100) / (Principal × Rate) ⇒ (7500 × 100) / (12500 × 8) = 7.5 years Hence, it will take 7.5 years for the sum to amount to Rs. 20000.

q_en: In a school there are total 414 students. The ratio of boys and girls is 5 ∶ 4. If 46 more boys gets admitted into the school, then what will be the new ratio of boys and girls?
e_en: Given: Total students = 414 Ratio of boys to girls = 5:4 Number of boys admitted = 46 Concept Used: The new ratio is determined by the increased number of boys and the unchanged number of girls. Calculation: Total parts = 5 + 4 = 9 Boys initially = 5/9 × 414 = 230 Girls = 414 - 230 = 184 New total boys = 230 + 46 = 276 New ratio of boys to girls = 276:184 = 92 × 3 : 92 × 2 = 3:2 Hence, the new ratio of boys to girls is 3:2.

q_en: What is the total surface area of a cylinder having radius of base as 7 cm and height as 5 cm?
e_en: Given: Radius (r) = 7 cm Height (h) = 5 cm Concept: Total Surface Area of a cylinder = 2πr(h + r) Calculation: Total Surface Area = 2π × 7 × (5 + 7) = 2π × 7 × 12 = 528 cm² Hence, the total surface area of the cylinder is 528 cm².

q_en: The average of 5 consecutive even numbers is A. If next 5 even numbers are also included, then what is the average of these 10 numbers?
e_en: Given: The average of 5 consecutive even numbers is A Calculation: Let X is an even number. So 5 five consecutive even numbers = X, X + 2, X + 4, X + 6 and X + 8 Avg = [5X + (2 + 4 + 6 + 8)] /5 = X + 4 = A and if the next five even numbers X + 10, X + 12, X + 14, X + 16 and X + 18 are also included then Average will become = [10X + 2(1 + 2 + ... + 9)]/10 = (10X + 90) / 10 = X + 9 = A + 5 Hence, A + 5 is the correct answer.

q_en: An article is sold for Rs. 1,260 after giving a discount of 40%. What is the marked priced of this article?

q_en: If (2 cos³ A - cos A) = (sin A - 2 sin³ A), then what is the value of A?
e_en: Given: (2 cos3 A - cos A) = (sin A - 2 sin3 A) Calculation: (2 cos3 A - cos A) = (sin A - 2 sin3 A) ⇒ (2 cos3 A + 2 sin3 A) = (sin A + cos A) ⇒ 2(cos A + sin A)(cos2 A + sin2 A - sin A.cos A) = (cos A + sin A) ⇒ 2(1 - sin A.cos A) = 1 ⇒ 2sin A.cos A = 1 ⇒ sin 2A = 1 = sin 90° ⇒ 2A = 90° ⇒ A = 45° Hence, the value of A is 45°.

q_en: A and B together can complete a work in 20 days. A is 20 percent more efficient than B. B alone can complete the same work in how many days?
e_en: Given: A and B can complete the work in 20 days. A is 20% more efficient than B. Concept used: Total Wok Done = Number of Days × Efficiency Calculation: The ratio of efficiency of A and B = 6 : 5 Let the efficiencies (work is done per day) of A, and B be 6x and 5x respectively. Total Wok Done = Number of Days × Efficiency ⇒ 20 × (6x + 5x) ⇒ 20 × 11x ⇒ 220x The time is taken by B alone to complete the work = 220x/5x ⇒ 44 days ∴ B can complete the whole work in 44 days.

q_en: If a⁴ + (1)/(a⁴) = 194, then what is the value of (a⁶+1)/(a³) ?
e_en: Given: a⁴ + (1)/(a⁴) = 194 Identity used: (a + b)2 = a2 + b2 + 2ab If (x + 1/x) = p then (x3 + 1/x3) = p3 - 3p Calculation: a4 + 1/a4 = 194 Adding 2 on both sides we'll get ⇒ a4 + 1/a4 + 2 = 194 + 2 = (a2 + 1/a2)2 Then, (a2 + 1/a2) = √196 = 14 Again adding 2 on both sides, we'll get ⇒ a2 + 1/a2 + 2 = 14 + 2 = (a + 1/a)2 Then, (a + 1/a) = √16 = 4 ⇒ a3 + 1/a3 = (a + 1/a)3 - 3 × (a + 1/a) = 43 - 3 × 4 ⇒ a3 + 1/a³ = 52 ⇒ (a⁶ + 1)/a³ = 52 ∴ Option C is the correct answer.

q_en: A person borrows Rs. 20000 at the rate of 6 percent per annum on simple interest for 3 years. He immediately lends it to another person at the rate of 8.5 percent per annum on simple interest for 3 years. What is the value of gain per year?

q_en: If (x-(1)/(x)=4), then what is the value of (x⁶+(1)/(x⁶)) ?

q_en: The average of 15 numbers is 53. A number is removed and the average of 14 numbers now becomes 55. Which number was removed?
e_en: Given: The average of 15 numbers is 53. The average of 14 numbers is 55. Calculation: Let's denote: N = the number that was removed. The sum of the initial 15 numbers can be calculated as 15 × Average = 15 × 53 = 795. The sum of the 14 remaining numbers can be calculated as 14 × Average = 14 × 55 = 770. The number removed is the difference between these two sums: N = 795 - 770 = 25 So, the number that was removed is 25.

q_en: There are 5 numbers, where first number is double of second number and two-third of third number. The average of 5 numbers is 60. If the sum of remaining two numbers is 120, then find the value of the 3rd number.
e_en: Given: Average of 5 numbers = 60 Sum of remaining two numbers = 120 Concept: Average = Total sum / Number of elements. Calculation: Let's call the first number x. Then we know: ⇒ The second number = x/2, the third number = 3x/2, and the remaining two numbers = 120. ⇒ The sum of all 5 numbers = 60 × 5 = 300. ⇒ x + x/2 + 3x/2 + 120 = 300 ⇒ 3x = 180 ⇒ x = 60 We find that x = 60. The third number is therefore 3x/2 = 3 × 60/2 = 90 Therefore, the value of the 3rd number is 90.

q_en: If sum of squares of two real numbers is 12 and the product of the numbers is 4, find the difference between the numbers.

q_en: The average weight of 100 students is 34 kg. The average weight of first 49 students is 34 kg and of last 50 students is 32 kg. What is the weight of the 50th student?
e_en: Given: Average weight of 100 students = 34 kg Average weight of first 49 students = 34 kg Average weight of last 50 students = 32 kg Concept used: Average = sum of the elements/number of elements Calculation: Total weight of 100 students = 100 × 34 = 3400 kg Total weight of first 49 students = 34 × 49 = 1666kg Total weight of last 50 students = 50 × 32 = 1600 kg The weight of 50th student = 3400 - 1666 - 1600 = 134kg. ∴ The weight of the 50th student is 134 kg.

q_en: In an examination, 45 percent of students passed in history and 60 percent of students passed in Hindi. If 8 percent of students failed in both subjects, then what percentage of students passed in both subjects?

So, the total percentage who passed either in history or Hindi (or both) is 45% + 60% = 105%. But this sum also includes the students who passed in both subjects twice (once for history and once for Hindi). Also, we know that 8% of students failed in both subjects.

q_en: If 2Cos² θ − 9 cos θ + 7 = 0, then what is the value of cos² θ + sec² θ?
e_en: Given: 2Cos2 θ − 9 cos θ + 7 = 0 Concept Used: cos θ = 1/sec θ Calculation: 2Cos2 θ − 9 cos θ + 7 = 0 Solving for secθ, we have a quadratic equation in secθ: 2Cos2 θ − 9 cos θ + 7 = 0 This can be factored as follows: (2 cos θ - 7)(cos θ - 1) = 0. Setting each factor equal to zero gives the solutions cos θ = 3.5 or cos θ = 1. As cos θ = 3.5 is not possible so we take cos θ = 1. cos2 θ + sec2 θ 1/sec2 θ + sec2 θ 1 + 1 = 2 ∴ Option A is the correct answer.

q_en: If angle made by a chord on the major arc of a circle is 50 degree, then what will be the angle made by same chord on the minor arc of this circle?
e_en: Concept Used: In a circle, the following property holds: the angle that a chord subtends on the major arc is 180 degrees minus the angle that the same chord subtends on the minor arc. This is due to the fact that any point on a circle defines an angle of 360 degrees. Calculation: So, if the angle made by a chord on the major arc is ∠ACB = 50°, then the angle that the same chord makes on the minor arc of the circle would be ∠ACB = 180 - 50 = 130°.

q_en: How many numbers are there from 17 to 457 which are divisible by both 5 and 3?
e_en: Calculation: If a number is divisible by both 5 and 3, it means that it's divisible by the least common multiple (LCM) of 5 and 3. LCM(5, 3) = 15. Now, we need to find how many numbers between 17 and 457 are divisible by 15. To do this, we can follow these steps: Find the smallest multiple of 15 greater than or equal to 17. This is 30 (15 × 2). Find the largest multiple of 15 less than or equal to 457. This is 450 (15 × 30).

q_en: 150 litre mixture of milk and water contains 30 percent milk. How much more milk must be added to make water percentage in the mixture as 40 percent?
e_en: Given: 150 litre mixture of milk and water contains 30 percent milk. Calculation: The initial volume of the mixture is 150 litres, of which 30% is milk. So the volume of milk in the mixture is 30% of 150 litres = 0.3 × 150 = 45 litres. Therefore, the volume of water in the mixture is 150 - 45 = 105 litres. q_en: If a - b = 8 and 4ab = 84, then what is the value of 3a³ - 3b³?

Time taken by train = d / 50, Time taken by walking = d / 10 d/50 + d/10 = 12 d = 500/5 ⇒ d = 100 km Hence, the distance traveled by train is 100 km.

q_en: A shopkeeper sells a table at a discount of 20 percent and earns a profit of 30 percent. If he sells the same table at 10 percent discount, then what will be his new profit or loss percent?
e_en: Given: Selling price at 20% discount with 30% profit Selling price at 10% discount Solution: Let the original price (marked price) be 100 After a 20% discount, the selling price is 80% of 100 = 80 This is also the cost price with 30% profit, so 80 = 1.3 * (Cost Price) ⇒ Cost Price = 80/1.3 Now, selling price with 10% discount is 90% of 100 = 90.

e_en: Given: (k + 1/k)² = 9 Formula used: (k³ + 1/k³) = (k + 1/k)³ - 3(k + 1/k) Calculation: (k + 1/k)2 = 9 k + 1/k = 3 (k3 + 1/k3) = (k + 1/k)3 - 3(k + 1/k) (k3 + 1/k3) = (3)3 - 3(3) (k3 + 1/k3) = 27 - 9 (k3 + 1/k3) = 18 ∴ Option B is the correct answer.

q_en: If the price of a product is first increased by 15% and then decreased by 20%, then what is the percent change in the price?

q_en: Student A got 25 marks more than the student B and the marks of A were equal to the 60 percent of the sum of their marks. What are the marks obtained by A and B respectively?

Solution: Let marks of B = x. Then, marks of A = x + 25. From the second condition, x + 25 = 0.6 × (x + x + 25) ⇒ x + 25 = 0.6 × (2x + 25) Solving the equation, we get x = 50. Solution: If we let 4x be the income of A and 5x be the income of B, we can write down the savings of A and B as equations: 4x - 5y = 6000 and 5x - 4y = 12000, where y is the unit of expenditure. q_en: Due to an increase of 20 percent in the price of rice, the consumer decreases his consumption by 5 percent. What is the percentage change in total expenditure?
e_en: Given: Increase in price = 20% Decrease in consumption = 5% Concept: Percentage change in expenditure = Percentage change in price - Percentage change in consumption - (Percentage change in price × Percentage change in consumption) / 100 Solution: Percentage change in expenditure = 20% - 5% - (20% × 5%)/100 15% - 1% = 14% Therefore, the percentage change in total expenditure is 14%.

q_en: If a + b = 3 and ab = 2, then what is the value of 2a³ + 2b³?
e_en: Given: a + b = 3 ab = 2 Concept: This is the formula to simplify cubic expressions: a³ + b³ = (a + b)(a² - ab + b²) Solution: 2a³ + 2b³ = 2(a³ + b³) 2(a + b)(a² - ab + b²) (Substituting from given) 2(3)(a² - 2 + b²) (as a + b = 3 and ab = 2) 2(3)(a² + b² - 2) (as a² + b² = (a + b)² - 2ab = 9 - 4 = 5) 2(3)(5 - 2) = 2(3)(3) = 18 fore, the value of 2a³ + 2b³ is 18.

q_en: In a cyclic quadrilateral A B C D, ∠A is opposite to ∠C. If ∠A = 110 degree, then what is the value of ∠C?

q_en: Selling price of a watch is Rs. 1056 and profit percentage is 10 percent. If selling price is Rs. 800 , then what will be the loss percentage?
e_en: Given: Selling Price (SP1) = Rs. 1056 Profit % = 10% New Selling Price (SP2) = Rs. 800 Concept: Profit and loss are calculated on the Cost Price (CP). Solution: Find the Cost Price (CP) using the first set of information: CP = SP1 / (1 + Profit%) = Rs. 1056 / (1 + 10/100) = Rs. 960 Find the loss% using the second set of information: Loss% = ((CP - SP2) / CP) × 100 = ((960 - 800) / 960) × 100 = 16.67% Hence, the loss percentage will be 16.67%.

q_en: The marked price of an article is 150 percent of the cost price. If 20 percent discount is given, then what will be the profit percentage?
e_en: Given: Marked price is 150% of the cost price Discount given is 20% Concept: Profit percentage is calculated as (Selling price - Cost price)/Cost price × 100% Solution: Selling price after discount = 150% - 20% of 150% = 150% - 30% = 120% Profit percentage = (Selling price - Cost price)/Cost price × 100% = (120% - 100%)/100% × 100% = 20% Therefore, the profit percentage is 20%.

q_en: An amount of Rs.12,029 is divided among P, Q and R such that P's share is 5 times Q's share and R's share is one-third of P's share. What is the share of R?

Solution: Express all shares in terms of Q: P = 5Q, R = 5Q/3 Total = P + Q + R = 5Q + Q + 5Q/3 = 12,029 Solving the above equation we get Q = Rs. 1569 Therefore, R's share = 5Q/3 = 5 × 1569/3 = Rs. 2615 Therefore, the share of R is Rs. 2615.

q_en: The average runs scored by a batsman in 7 matches is 49 and in other 9 matches the average is 27. What is the average runs scored by the batsman in these 16 matches?
e_en: Given: Average runs in 7 matches = 49 Average runs in 9 matches = 27 Concept: The total average is the sum of all runs divided by the total number of matches. Solution: Total runs in 7 matches = 7 × 49 = 343 Total runs in 9 matches = 9 × 27 = 243 Total runs in 16 matches = 343 + 243 = 586 Average runs in 16 matches = 586/16 = 36.625 Therefore, the average runs scored by the batsman in these 16 matches is 36.625.

q_en: If the 4-digit number 48ab is divisible by 2, 5 and 7, then what is the value of (10a - b) ?

q_en: 8 men or 10 boys can complete a work in 174 days. 12 men and 14 boys will complete the same work in how many days?

Formula: Work = (Men × Days)/(Rate) Solution: Let the rate of one man be m and the rate of one boy be b. 8m = 10b m/b = 5/4 Efficiency of Men = 5 and Boys = 4 (12m + 14b) × Days = (8m × 174 days) (12 × 5 + 14 × 4) × Days = (8 × 5 × 174 days) (12 × 5 + 14 × 4) × Days = (8 × 5 × 174 days) 116 × Days = (8 × 5 × 174) 6960/116 = 60 Days Days = 60 Therefore, 12 men and 14 boys will complete the same work in 60 days.

q_en: If sin θ - cos θ = 1/5, then find the value of sin θ + cos θ.

q_en: If 2x + 3y = 9, and xy = 3, what is 8x³ + 27y³?
e_en: Given: 2x + 3y = 9 and xy = 3 Concept used: (a + b)² = a² + b² + 2ab a³ + b³ = (a + b)(a² - ab + b²) Calculation: 2x + 3y = 9 on squaring both side we get (2x + 3y)² = 9² ⇒ 4x² + 9y² + 12xy = 81 ⇒ 4x² + 9y² + 12 × 3 = 81 ⇒ 4x² + 9y² = 45 now, 8x³ + 27y³ = (2x)³ + (3y)³ ⇒ (2x)³ + (3y)³ = (2x + 3y)(4x² - 6xy + 9y²) ⇒ (2x)³ + (3y)³ = 9 × (45 - 6 × 3) ⇒ 243 ∴ The answer is 243.

q_en: What is the difference between the compound interest on ₹6,400 for 1 year at 5% per annum compounded yearly and half-yearly?
e_en: Given: Principal = Rs.6400 Time = 1 year and rate = 5% Concept used: Compound interest (C.I) = P × Effective rate% Effective rate% for 2 years = R₁ + R₂ + (R₁ × R₂)/100 Calculation: For compounded annually: C.I = 6400 × 5% = 320 For compounded half-yearly: New rate = 5/2% = 2.5% Time = 1 × 2 = 2 years Effective rate% for 2 years = 2.5 + 2.5 + (2.5)²/100 ⇒ 5 + 0.0625 = 5.0625% C.I = 6400 × 5.0625% = Rs.324 Required difference = 324 - 320 = Rs.4 ∴ The correct answer is 4.

e_en: Given: (A + B + C) can complete the work = 9 days A can complete the work = 18 days B can complete the same work = 30 days Formula used: Total work = efficiency × time Calculation: Efficiency Person Time Total work 5 A 18 90 3 B 30 10 A + B + C 9 Now, ⇒ A + B + C = 10 ⇒ 5 + 3 + C = 10 ⇒ C = 2 Time taken to complete the work by C = 90/2 = 45 days ∴ The correct answer is 45 days.

q_en: Two circles of radius 2.4 cm and 4 cm, respectively, have a common tangent. The distance between the centres of the two circles is 6.5 cm. If the common tangent does not intersect the line joining the centres, then find the length of a common tangent to the circles.
e_en: Given: O₂E (r2)= 2.4 cm O₁D (r1) = 4 cm Distance between centers (d) = O1O2 = 6.5 cm Formula used: Common tangent = √{d² - (r₁ - r₂)²} Calculation: Common tangent (DE) = √{d2 - (r1 - r2)2} ⇒ √{(6.5)2 - (4 - 2.4)2} ⇒ √{(42.25 - (1.6)2} ⇒ √{(42.25 - 2.56} ⇒ √39.69 = 6.3 cm ∴ The correct answer is 6.3 cm.

q_en: The average of 18 integers is found to be 41. It was detected that by mistake the integer 127 was copied as 341, while calculating the average. Then the correct average is:
e_en: Given: The average of 18 integers = 41 By mistake 127 was copied as 341 Formula Used: Average = Sum of all values / Total no of values Calculation: Using formula, sum of integers = 18 × 41 = 738 Difference between actual value and copied value = 341 - 127 = 214 So, the actual sum = 738 - 214 = 524 Thus, the correct average = 524 / 18 = 29 1/9 ∴ The correct average of integers = 29 1/9.

q_en: A shopkeeper marks his goods at 90% more than their cost price and allows a discount of 40% on the marked price. His gain percentage is:
e_en: Given: Marked price = 190% × C.P Discount = 40% Concept used: If discount = D% Selling price = M.P × (100 - D)% Gain = Selling price - cost price Gain% = (Gain × 100)/cost price Calculation: Let the C.P = 100x Marked price = 100x × 190% = Rs.190x Selling price = 190x × (100 - 40)% ⇒ 190 × 60% = 114x Gain% = {(114x - 100x) × 100}/100x ⇒ 14% ∴ The correct answer is 14%.

q_en: The lengths of the two sides of a triangle are 14 cm and 9 cm. Which of the options below can be the length of the third side?

(b) The difference of any two sides of a triangle will be smaller than the third side of that triangle. Solution: Checking option (A): Condition (1) ⇒14 + 9 > 17 ⇒ 23 > 17 ⇒14 + 17 > 9 ⇒ 31 > 9 ⇒17 + 9 > 14 ⇒ 26 > 14 Condition (2) ⇒14 - 9 ⇒17 - 14 ⇒17 - 9 Both the conditions are satisfied.

q_en: The marked price of a school bag was Rs. 550. This price was 10% above the cost price. It was sold at a discount of 10% on the marked price. Find the gain or loss percentage.
e_en: Given: MP of a school bag = Rs. 550 MP = CP + CP × 10/100 Discount on MP = 10% Formula used: Loss % = ((CP - SP) / CP ) × 100 Calculations: ⇒ 550 = (100 + 10)/100 × CP ⇒ CP = 550 × 100 / 110 = Rs. 500 According to the given data, ⇒ SP = MP × ((100 - 10))/(100) ⇒ SP = 550 × 90/100 = Rs. 495 Now, Loss% = (500 - 495)/500 × 100 ⇒ Loss% = 5/500 × 100 = 1 ∴ The loss percentage is 1%.

q_en: A sells a television to B for Rs. 4,860, thereby losing 19%. B sells it to C at a price which would have given A a 17% profit. Find the gain of B.
e_en: Given: Selling price (S.P) of A = Rs.4860 Loss% for A = 19% Concept used: If profit is P%, then Selling price (S.P) = Cost price (C.P) × (100 + P)% If the loss is L%, then Selling price (S.P) = Cost price (C.P) × (100 - L)% Calculation: C.P for A = (4860 × 100)/(100 - 19) ⇒ (4860 × 100)/81 ⇒ 60 × 100 = 6000 S.P of B = 6000 × 117% = Rs.7020 Gain for B = (7020 - 4860) = Rs.2160 ∴ The correct answer is Rs.2160.

e_en: Given: Replaced wine = 75 litres Number of replacements = 2 The ratio of the wine left in the cask after replacement = 3 ∶ 2 Formula used: Final = Initial(1 - x/c)ⁿ x = quantity withdrawn c = quantity withdrawn from n = No. of times Calculation: Since the quantity withdrawn is replaced by an equal amount of water, the final quantity remains the same.

Calculation: Prakash beats Ved by 280 m Prakash : Ved = 1000 : (1000 - 280) = 1000 : 720 = 25 : 18 -----(i) Ved beats Rahul by 100 m Ved : Rahul = 1000 : (1000 - 100) = 1000 : 900 = 10 : 9 ----- (ii) From 5 × (i) and 9 × (ii) A : B = 125 : 90 B : C = 90 : 81 Now, Prakash : Ved : Rahul = 125 : 90 : 81 Prakash : Rahul = 125 : 81 When Prakash covers 125 m then Rahul covers = 81 m Praka…

q_en: ΔLON and ΔLMN are two right-angled triangles with common hypotenuse LN such that ∠LON = 90° and ∠LMN = 90°. LN is the bisector of ∠OLM. If LN = 29 cm and ON = 20 cm, then what is the perimeter (in cm) of ΔLMN?
e_en: Given: ∠LON = 90° and ∠LMN = 90° LN = 29 cm and ON = 20 cm LN is the bisector of ∠OLM. Concept used: H² = P² + B² Congruence of triangles: Two triangles are said to be congruent if all three corresponding sides are equal and all three corresponding angles are equal in measure. Calculation: In the given figure, ΔLON and ΔLMN are congruent to each other as ∠LON = ∠LMN = 90° , LN = LN (common side), and ∠OLN = ∠NLM (angle bisector). Hence, by SAA, ΔLON and ΔLMN are congruent.

q_en: By selling a watch for Rs. 1,600, a person gets profit that is equal to the loss of selling the same watch for Rs. 1,400. If the person wants to get a profit of 20%, at what price should he sell the watch?
e_en: Given: Profit earned by selling at Rs. 1600 is same as the loss incurred by selling the article for Rs. 1400 Formula: Profit = SP – CP Loss = CP – SP Calculation: Let the cost price of the article be Rs. x, then 1600 – x = x – 1400 ⇒ x + x = 1600 + 1400 ⇒ 2x = 3000 ⇒ x = 1500 The cost price of the article is Rs.1500. ∴ The selling price of the article if it is sold at 20% profit = 1500 × (120/100) = Rs. 1800 The answer is 1800.

q_en: Two circles with diameters 50 cm and 58 cm, respectively, intersect each other at points A and B, such that the length of the common chord is 40 cm. Find the distance (in cm) between the centres of these two circles.
e_en: Given: r = 25 cm R = 29 cm Length of Common Chord = 40 cm Calculation: CE² = AC² – AE² ⇒ CE² = 25² – 20² ⇒ CE² = 625 – 400 ⇒ CE² = 225 ⇒ CE = √225 ⇒ CE = 15 cm ED² = AD² – AE² ⇒ ED² = 29² – 20² ⇒ ED² = 841 – 400 ⇒ ED² = 441 ⇒ ED = √441 ⇒ ED = 21 cm ∴ The distance between the centres of circles i.e CD = (15 + 21) = 36 cm The distance between the centres of circles is 36 cm.

q_en: At a certain annual rate (rounded off to the nearest integer) of simple interest, a sum of money becomes nine times its original value in 21 years. By how much does the rate of interest change if the same sum of money has to become 12 times its original value in 25 years?
e_en: Formula Used: RT = (n - 1)100 Calculation: ⇒ R × 21 = 8 × 100 ⇒ R = 800/21 = 38% And, ⇒ R × 25 = 11 × 100 ⇒ R = 1100/25 = 44% Difference = 44 - 38 = 6% ∴ The correct answer is 6%.

q_en: In a mixture, the ratio of a chemical X and water is 15 ∶ 9. When 48 litres of this mixture is replaced with water, the ratio becomes 11 ∶ 13. Find the quantity of water after replacement.
e_en: Given: Ratio of a chemical X and water is 15 ∶ 9. 48 litres of this mixture is replaced with water, the ratio becomes 11 ∶ 13. Calculation: 48 liters of water is taken out in which chemical X is 30 and water is 18. ⇒ 15x - 30/(9x - 18 + 48) = 11/13 ⇒ 15x - 30/(9x + 30) = 11/13 ⇒ 195x - 390 = 99x + 330 ⇒ 96x = 720 ⇒ x = 720/96 = 7.5 Quantity of water after replacement = 9 × 7.5 + 30 = 97.5 ∴ The correct answer is 97.5.

q_en: In triangle STU, V is a point on the side ST and W is a point on the side SU such that VWUT is a trapezium. Given that VW ∶ TU = 2 ∶ 7, what is the ratio of area of trapezium VWUT to the area of the triangle STU?

q_en: Sanjana can row a boat at 9 km/h in the still water. It takes her twice as long to row up a certain distance as to row down the same distance in the river. What is the rate of the stream (in km/h)?
e_en: Given: v = 9 km/hr Time Upstream = 2 × Downstream Formula Used: Speed in Downstream = v + u Speed in Upstream = v - u Calculation: ⇒ D/(v - u) = 2 × D/(v + u) ⇒ v + u = 2 × (v - u) ⇒ 9 + u = 2(9 - u) ⇒ 3u = 9 ⇒ u = 3 ∴ The correct answer is 3.

q_en: Aditya can complete the work of painting a grill in 20 hours while Vinay can complete the same work in 15 hours. If Aditya and Vinay both work together, then in how many hours will the grill painting work be completed?

q_en: If ({x}+(1)/({x)})=5, then the value of (x⁵+(1)/(x⁵)) is:

e_en: Given: Discount = 20% Gain = 15% The cost price of the article = Rs. 5600 Formula used: SP = (100 + gain%)/100 × CP Discount = MP – SP Marked price = [100/(100 – Discount%) × SP] Calculation: The cost price of the article = Rs. 5600 Selling price of the article = [(100 + gain%)/100 × CP] ⇒ [(100 + 15)/100 × 5600] ⇒ (115/100 × 5600) ⇒ 6440 Now, Marked price = [100/(100 – Discount%) × SP] ⇒ [100/(100 – 20) × 6440] ⇒ (100/80 × 6440) = 8050 The answer is 8050.

q_en: In triangle RST, M and N are two points on RS and RT such that MN is parallel to the base ST of the triangle RST. If RM = 1 over 3 MS, and ST = 5.6 cm, what is the ratio of the area of Δ RMN to the area of trapezium MNST?

e_en: Given: Metallic sphere of radius 21 cm The radius and height are 7 cm and 3 cm Formula used: The volume of sphere = 4/3 × π × (r)3 Volume of one cone = 1/3 × π × (r)2 × h Calculation: The volume of sphere = 4/3 × π × (21)3 Volume of one cone = 1/3 × π × (7)2 × 3 The number of cones obtained = (4/3 × π × (21)3)/(1/3 × π × (7)2 × 3) = 4 × 3 × 21 = 252 The answer is 252.

q_en: An item was sold at Rs. 5,474 after two successive discounts of 12.5% and 8% were offered on its Marked Price. What was the Marked Price (in Rs.) of the item?
e_en: GIVEN: The selling price is Rs 5474 Successive discounts are 12.5% and 8% FORMULA USED: S.P. = (1 - d1/100 ) × ( 1- d2/100) × M.P. Where, S.P. = Selling price , M.P. = Marked price , d1 and d2 are successive discount percent respectively CALCULATION: We know that, S.P. = ( 1- d1/100 ) × ( 1- d2/100) × M.P. ⇒ 5474 = ( 1- 12.5/100 ) × ( 1 - 8/100) × M.P. ⇒ 5474 = 7/8 × 23/25 × M.P. ⇒ M.P = 8 × 25 × 34 ⇒ M.P. = 6800 Hence, the Marked Price of an article is Rs 6800.

q_en: If ax + by = 1 and bx + ay = (2ab)/(a²+b²), then the value of x (in terms of a and b) is:
e_en: Calculation: ax + by = 1 -----------(1) bx + ay = 2ab/(a²+ b²) ------------(2) On dividing eq 1/2 we get, ⇒ (ax + by)/(bx + ay) = (a² + b²)/2ab ⇒ 2a²xb + 2ab²y = a²bx + b³x + a³y + ab²y ⇒ a²xb + ab²y = b³x + a³y ⇒ a²bx - b³x = a³y - ab²y ⇒ x(a²b - b³) = y(a³ - ab²) ⇒ x/y = (a³ - ab²)/(a²b - b³) ⇒ x/y = a(a² - b²)/b(a² - b²) x/y =a/b -----------(3) Now putting value of x and y from eq (3) in eq (1) we get, x = a/(a² + b²) The answer is a/(a2 + b2).

q_en: A money lender lent Rs. 30,000 in two parts, one at the rate of 8% and the other at 9%. If the total annual simple interest on the amount is Rs. 2,650, then what is the amount of money lent at the rate of 8%?
e_en: Given: Principal = 30000 Rate = 8% and 9% Interest = 2650 Formula used: S.I. = (P × R × T)/100 Calculation: Let money lender lend Rs. 'a' at 8% and Rs. (30000 – a) at 9% interest S.I. = (P × R × T)/100 ⇒ 2650 = (a × 8 × 1)/100 + ((30000 – a) × 9 × 1)/100 ⇒ 265000 = a × 8 × 1 + (30000 – a) × 9 × 1 ⇒ 265000 = 8a + 270000 – 9a ⇒ a = 5000 The amount of money lent at the rate of 8% is 5000.

q_en: A can complete a piece of work in 9 days. B and C can complete the same work in 12 days and 18 days respectively. If A, B, C work together, then in how many days will they complete the work?

q_en: The marked price on a fancy item is Rs. 250 but there is an 18% discount during festival season. The price of the fancy item after discount is:
e_en: Given: The marked price of a fancy item = Rs. 250 Discount = 18%. Formula: S.P = M.P × (100 - D%)/100 Where, S.P = Selling price M.P = Marked price D = Discount% Calculation: S.P = M.P × (100 - D%)/100 ⇒ 250 × (100 - 18)/100 ⇒ 250 × 0.82 = 205 ∴ The selling price of a fancy item is Rs. 205.

q_en: The average weight of 64 students is 48 kg and the average weight of another class of 32 students is 24 kg. Find the average weight of both classes combined.
e_en: Given: The average weight of 48 students is 64 kg The average weight of 32 students is 24 kg Concept used: Average = (The sum of all items)/(The total number of items) Calculation: The total weight of 64 students = 64 × 48 = 3072 The total weight of 32 students = 32 × 24 = 768 The combined average weight of the classes = (3072 + 768)/(96) = 40 kg ∴ The average weight of both classes combined is 40 kg.

q_en: The centres of two circles are 84 cm apart. If the radii of these two circles are 38 cm and 26 cm, respectively, then which of the following options gives the length (in cm) of a direct common tangent of these two circles?
e_en: Given: Distance between the centers = 84 cm Radius of first circle (r₁) = 38 cm Radius of second circle (r₂) = 26 cm Formula used: Length of direct common tangent (L) = √(d² - (r₁ - r₂)²) Where d = distance between the centers, r₁ and r₂ are the radii of the circles. Calculation: ⇒ L = √(84² - (38 - 26)²) ⇒ L = √(7056 - 12²) ⇒ L = √(7056 - 144) ⇒ L = √6912 ⇒ L = 48√3 cm ∴ The length of the direct common tangent is approximately 48√3 cm.

q_en: Ramu mixes 2 litres of water at 100° C and 18 litres of water at 32° C. What temperature will the water have after mixing?
e_en: Given: Water quantities and temperatures: Water 1: 2 litres at 100°C Water 2: 18 litres at 32°C Formula used: Final temperature (T) after mixing = (m₁ × T₁ + m₂ × T₂) / (m₁ + m₂) Where m₁ and m₂ are the masses (or volumes in this case, since the density of water is uniform), and T₁ and T₂ are the temperatures of the water.

q_en: After the division of a number successively by 2,3 and 5, the remainders are 1,2 and 3, respectively. What will be the remainder, if 13 divides the same number (if the last quotient is 1)?
e_en: Formula used: Dividend = Divisor × Quotient + Remainder Calculation: The number X in this case will be determined as follows: We know that, Dividend = Divisor × Quotient + Remainder Z = (5 × 1) + 3 = 8 Y = (3 × Z) + 2 = (3 × 8) + 2 = 26 X = (2 × Y) + 1 = (2 × 26) + 1 = 53 ∴ X = 53 According to question, When (X) is divided by 13 i.e. 53/13, then the remainder will be 1. ∴ Remainder of 53/13 = 1.

e_en: Given: ∠BXC = 125º Formula Used: In a circle, the angle between the tangents (∠BAC) is equal to the difference between 180º and the angle subtended at the center (∠BXC). ∠BAC = (180º - ∠BXC) Calculation: ∠BXC = 125º So, ∠BAC = 180º - 125º = 55º ∴ The correct measure of ∠BAC is 55º.

q_en: When x is added to each of the numbers 7, 11, 18 and 23, then the number so obtained are in proportion. What is the mean proportional between the (x - 1) and (2x - 10)?
e_en: Calculations: The numbers after adding x to 7, 11, 18, and 23 will be: 7 + x, 11 + x, 18 + x, and 23 + x. Since they are in proportion: 7 + x / 11 + x = 18 + x / 23 + x Cross multiplying, we get: (7 + x)(23 + x) = (11 + x)(18 + x) Expanding both sides: 161 + 30x + x² = 198 + 29x + x² Canceling x² from both sides: 161 + 30x = 198 + 29x Simplifying: 30x - 29x = 198 - 161 x = 37 Now, we need to find the mean proportional between x - 1 and 2x - 10.

q_en: M varies inversely as (N² + 3). If M = 3 when N = 3, then what will be the value of M when N² = 69?
e_en: Given: M varies inversely as (N² + 3). M = 3 when N = 3. N² = 69. Formula Used: M = k / (N² + 3) Calculation: When N = 3: ⇒ M = 3 ⇒ 3 = k / (3² + 3) ⇒ 3 = k / (9 + 3) ⇒ 3 = k / 12 ⇒ k = 3 × 12 ⇒ k = 36 When N² = 69: ⇒ M = 36 / (69 + 3) ⇒ M = 36 / 72 ⇒ M = 1 / 2 The value of M when N² = 69 is 1/2.

Formula used: Dividend = Divisor × Quotient + Remainder Calculation: 2 A 1 3 B 4 5 C 0 7 D 5 1 D = 7 × 1 + 5 = 12 ⇒ C = 5 × 12 + 0 = 60 ⇒ B = 3 × 60 + 4 = 184 ⇒ A = 2 × 184 + 1 = 369 Now, reverse the order of divisors: 7 369 5 5 52 2 3 10 1 2 3 1 ∴ The sum of the remainders = 5 + 2 + 1 + 1 = 9.

q_en: The area of three adjacent faces of a cuboidal box is 120 cm² , 72 cm² and 60 cm² , respectively. Find the volume (in cm³ ) of the box.

We have: l × b = 120 b × h = 72 h × l = 60 Volume of the cuboid (V) = l × b × h = √(l × b × b × h × h × l) Calculation: V = √(120 × 72 × 60) ⇒ V = √518400 ⇒ V = 720 cm³ ∴ The volume of the cuboid is 720 cm³.

e_en: Given: The sum of a two-digit number and the number obtained by interchanging the digits is 77. The difference of the digits is 1. Formula used: Let the two-digit number be 10x + y. The number obtained by interchanging the digits = 10y + x. Given that: (10x + y) + (10y + x) = 77 x - y = 1 Calculation: ⇒ 11x + 11y = 77 ⇒ x + y = 7 Now, x - y = 1 Solving these two equations: ⇒ x = 4, y = 3 The number = 10x + y = 10(4) + 3 = 43 ∴ The correct answer is option (B), 34.

q_en: A and B, working together, take 15 days to complete a piece of work. If A alone can do this work in 18 days, then how long would B take to complete the same work?
e_en: Given: A and B together complete the work in 15 days. A alone completes the work in 18 days. Formula Used: Work rate of A = 1/Time taken by A Work rate of B = 1/Time taken by B Combined work rate of A and B = Work rate of A + Work rate of B Calculation: Work rate of A = 1/18 Work rate of A and B together = 1/15 Let the time taken by B alone to complete the work be B days.

q_en: The average of the areas of 2 similar triangles is 706.5 m² whose perimeters are in the ratio of 6 ∶ 11. What is 20% of the difference (in m²) in areas of both triangles?
e_en: Given: The average of the areas of 2 similar triangles is 706.5 m² whose perimeters are in the ratio of 6 ∶ 11. Formula used: If the perimeters of two similar triangles are in the ratio a : b, then the ratio of their areas will be a² : b². Calculation: Let the areas of the two triangles be A1 and A2. Given the average area, we have: (A1 + A2) / 2 = 706.5 ⇒ A1 + A2 = 706.5 × 2 ⇒ A1 + A2 = 1413 The ratio of their areas will be (6²) : (11²) = 36 : 121.

e_en: Given: The radius of a sphere is increased by 5%. Formula used: Surface Area of Sphere = 4πr² Calculation: Let the original radius be r. New radius = r + 5% of r = r + 0.05r = 1.05r Original surface area = 4πr² New surface area = 4π(1.05r)² ⇒ New surface area = 4π(1.1025r²) ⇒ New surface area = 4πr² × 1.1025 Percentage increase in surface area = (New surface area - Original surface area) / Original surface area × 100 ⇒ Percentage increase = (4πr² × 1.1025 - 4πr²) / 4πr² × 100…

q_en: A shopkeeper marks an article at Rs. 150 and sells it at a discount of 25%. He also gives a gift worth Rs. 2.5. If he still makes a 10% profit, then the cost price (in Rs.) of the article is:
e_en: Given: Marked Price (MP) = ₹150 Discount = 25% of ₹150 = ₹37.50 Gift worth = ₹2.50 Profit = 10% Formula used: Selling Price (SP) = MP - Discount - Gift worth Profit = SP - Cost Price (CP) Profit% = ((SP - CP))/(CP) × 100 SP = CP + Profit Calculation: ⇒ SP = ₹150 - ₹37.50 - ₹2.50 ⇒ SP = ₹110 ⇒ Profit% = ((SP - CP))/(CP) × 100 ⇒ 10% = ((110 - CP))/(CP) × 100 ⇒ 1/10 = ((110 - CP))/(CP) ⇒ CP = 1100 - 10 CP ⇒ 11CP = 1100 ⇒ CP = ₹100 ∴ The cost price of the article is ₹100.

q_en: Let C be a circle with Centre O and P be an external point to C. Let PQ and PR be the tangents to C such that Q and R be the points of tangency, respectively. If ∠ROQ = 110°, find ∠RPQ.
e_en: Given: Centre of the circle, O External point, P PQ and PR are tangents to the circle at Q and R respectively ∠ROQ = 110° Formula Used: ∠PQR = 90° and ∠PRQ = 90° (radius of a circle and a tangent line are always perpendicular to each other) Sum of all angles of Quadrilateral = 360° Calculation: ∠ROQ = 110° Using the formula: ∠ROQ + ∠PQR + ∠PRQ + ∠RPQ = 360° ⇒ 110° + 90° + 90° +∠RPQ = 360° ⇒ ∠RPQ = 360° - 290° ⇒ ∠RPQ = 70° The correct answer is option C: 70°

Future Value (A) = Principal (P) + SI SI = P × 5 × 4 / 100 SI = P × 20 / 100 SI = 0.2P Future Value (A) = P + 0.2P ₹6,600 = P + 0.2P ₹6,600 = 1.2P ⇒ P = ₹6,600 / 1.2 ⇒ P = ₹5,500 The sum is ₹5,500.

q_en: The measures of the three angles of a triangle are such that the smallest angle measures 42º less than the greatest angle, while the measure of the remaining angle is 24º more than the measure of the smallest angle. Find the measure of the smallest angle of the triangle.
e_en: Given: The smallest angle measures 42º less than the greatest angle. The remaining angle is 24º more than the smallest angle. Formula Used: Sum of angles in a triangle = 180º Calculation: Let the smallest angle be x º. Largest angle = x + 42 º Remaining angle = x + 24° Sum of angles: x + (x + 42) + (x + 24) = 180 º ⇒ 3x + 66 = 180 ⇒ 3x = 180 - 66 ⇒ 3x = 114 ⇒ x = 38 Smallest angle = x = 38°. The measure of the smallest angle of the triangle is 38º.

Formula used: Time taken at 3 km/h: T + 1/2 = D / 3 Time taken at 4 km/h: T - 1/2 = D / 4 Calculation: From equation (1): T = (D / 3) - 1/2 From equation (2): T = (D / 4) + 1/2 Equating both: (D / 3) - 1/2 = (D / 4) + 1/2 ⇒ (4D - 3D) / 12 = 1 ⇒ D / 12 = 1 ⇒ D = 12 ∴ The distance to the destination is 12 km.

q_en: To finish a work, P takes half of the number of days required by Q to finish it. If they together can finish the work in 36 days, then in how many days Q alone can finish the work?
e_en: Given: P takes half of the number of days required by Q to finish the work. P and Q together can finish the work in 36 days. Formula used: Work done together = 1/P + 1/Q Calculation: Let Q alone can finish the work in Q days. ⇒ P alone can finish the work in Q/2 days. ⇒ 1/(Q/2) + 1/Q = 1/36 ⇒ 2/Q + 1/Q = 1/36 ⇒ 3/Q = 1/36 ⇒ Q = 36×3 ⇒ Q = 108 days ∴ The correct answer is option A.

Side = 14 m Perimeter = 4 × Side ⇒ Perimeter = 4 × 14 ⇒ Perimeter = 56 m The perimeter of the rhombus is 56 m.

e_en: Given: AB = 22 cm PB = 14 cm CP = 8 cm Formula Used: Power of a Point Theorem: PA × PB = PC × PD Calculation: Let PA = x cm Since AB = 22 cm, PA = AB - PB = 22 - 14 = 8 cm Using the Power of a Point Theorem: PA × PB = PC × PD ⇒ 8 × 14 = 8 × PD ⇒ 112 = 8 × PD ⇒ PD = 112 / 8 ⇒ PD = 14 cm The value of PD is 14 cm.

q_en: Divide 25 into two parts such that 6 times of the larger part added to 4 times of the smaller part is equal to 130. Find the larger part.
e_en: Given: Total sum of the two parts = 25 6 times the larger part + 4 times the smaller part = 130 Formula Used: Let the larger part be x and the smaller part be 25 - x. 6x + 4(25 - x) = 130 Calculation: Let's solve the equation: 6x + 4(25 - x) = 130 ⇒ 6x + 100 - 4x = 130 ⇒ 2x + 100 = 130 ⇒ 2x = 130 - 100 ⇒ 2x = 30 ⇒ x = 30 / 2 ⇒ x = 15 The larger part is 15.

q_en: The cost price of a fan is Rs. 4,400. A merchant wants to make a 24% profit by selling it. At the time of sale, merchant declares a discount of 12% on the marked price. Find the marked price.
e_en: Given: Cost Price (CP) = ₹4,400 Profit Percentage = 24% Discount Percentage = 12% Formula used: Selling Price (SP) = CP × (1 + Profit Percentage/100) Marked Price (MP) = SP / (1 - Discount Percentage/100) Calculation: SP = 4400 × (1 + 24/100) ⇒ SP = 4400 × 1.24 ⇒ SP = 5456 MP = 5456 / (1 - 12/100) ⇒ MP = 5456 / 0.88 ⇒ MP = 6200 ∴ The correct answer is option (A).

q_en: Two circles of radii 3 units and r units, respectively, have a 6 units distance between their centers. If the length of the direct common tangent is sqrt35 units, then the value of r is ________ units.
e_en: Given: Radius of the first circle = 3 units Radius of the second circle = r units Distance between centers = 6 units Length of the direct common tangent = √35 units Formula used: Length of direct common tangent = √(d² - (r₁ - r₂)²) Calculation: √35 = √(6² - (3 - r)²) ⇒ 35 = 36 - (3 - r)² ⇒ (3 - r)² = 36 - 35 = 1 ⇒ 3 - r = ±1 ⇒ r = 3 + 1 = 4 units OR ⇒ r = 3 - 1 = 2 units So, the circle radius can be 2 units or 4 units.

q_en: Out of a class of 200 people, 50 people’s average marks is 40, and the remaining 150 people’s average is 60. Find the people’s weighted average.
e_en: Given: Out of a class of 200 people, 50 people's average marks is 40, and the remaining 150 people's average is 60. Formula used: Weighted Average = (Sum of all values) / (Total number of values) Calculation: Sum of marks of 50 people = 50 × 40 = 2000 Sum of marks of 150 people = 150 × 60 = 9000 Total sum of marks = 2000 + 9000 = 11000 Total number of people = 50 + 150 = 200 ⇒ Weighted Average = 11000 / 200 ⇒ Weighted Average = 55 ∴ The correct answer is option (D).

q_en: Let C be a circle with center O and PQ be the diameter of C. Let AB be a chord on C. If ∠QOB = 40°, ∠AOP = 80°, then find ∠AOB.

Calculation: ∠QOB = 40º ∠AOP = 80º Since PQ is the diameter, Let ∠AOB = xº ∠AOB + ∠AOP + ∠QOB = 180º (sum of angles on a straight line) ⇒ x + 80º + 40º = 180º ⇒ x + 120º = 180º ⇒ x = 180º - 120º ⇒ x = 60º ∴ The correct answer is option (C).

q_en: What should be added to each term of the ratio 5 : 11 so that the ratio becomes 3 : 5?
e_en: Given: Initial ratio = 5 : 11 Final ratio = 3 : 5 Formula used: If each term of the ratio a : b is increased by x, the new ratio becomes (a + x) : (b + x) Calculations: Let the number to be added to each term be x. e_en: Given: My father is 25 years older than me. The sum of our ages 5 years ago was 39 years. Formula used: Let my present age be x years. Father's present age = x + 25 years Sum of our ages 5 years ago = (x - 5) + (x + 25 - 5) = 39 Calculation: ⇒ (x - 5) + (x + 25 - 5) = 39 ⇒ x - 5 + x + 20 = 39 ⇒ 2x + 15 = 39 ⇒ 2x = 39 - 15 ⇒ 2x = 24 ⇒ x = 24 / 2 ⇒ x = 12 ∴ My present age is 12 years.

q_en: Find the surface area (in cm²) of a cardboard box in the shape of a cuboid whose length is 60 cm. breadth is half its length and height is one-third of its breadth.
e_en: Given: Length of the cuboid (l) = 60 cm Breadth of the cuboid (b) = ½ of its length = 60/2 = 30 cm Height of the cuboid (h) = ⅓ of its breadth = 30/3 = 10 cm Formula Used: Surface Area of a cuboid = 2(l×b + b×h + h×l) Calculation: Surface Area = 2(l×b + b×h + h×l) ⇒ Surface Area = 2(60×30 + 30×10 + 10×60) ⇒ Surface Area = 2(1800 + 300 + 600) ⇒ Surface Area = 2(2700) ⇒ Surface Area = 5400 cm² The surface area of the cardboard box is 5400 cm².

q_en: If a ∶ b = 3 ∶ 7 and b ∶ c = 4 ∶ 9, then find a ∶ b ∶ c.
e_en: Given: If a ∶ b = 3 ∶ 7 and b ∶ c = 4 ∶ 9 Formula used: To find a ∶ b ∶ c, we need to make the values of b in both ratios equal. Calculation: a ∶ b = 3 ∶ 7 b ∶ c = 4 ∶ 9 Make the value of b equal in both ratios: LCM of 7 and 4 = 28 Convert a ∶ b to have b = 28: 3 ∶ 7 = 3×4 ∶ 7×4 = 12 ∶ 28 Convert b ∶ c to have b = 28: 4 ∶ 9 = 4×7 ∶ 9×7 = 28 ∶ 63 Combine to get a ∶ b ∶ c: 12 ∶ 28 ∶ 63 ∴ The correct answer is option C.

q_en: Find the remainder when 179 × 172 × 173 is divided by 17.
e_en: Given: Find the remainder when 179 × 172 × 173 is divided by 17. Formula used: Using the property of modular arithmetic: (a × b) mod m = [(a mod m) × (b mod m)] mod m Calculation: 179 mod 17 = 179 - (17 × 10) = 179 - 170 = 9 172 mod 17 = 172 - (17 × 10) = 172 - 170 = 2 173 mod 17 = 173 - (17 × 10) = 173 - 170 = 3 ⇒ 179 × 172 × 173 mod 17 = (9 × 2 × 3) mod 17 ⇒ 54 mod 17 = 54 - (17 × 3) = 54 - 51 = 3 ∴ The correct answer is option C.

Calculation: We have, ⇒ 42 ÷ 3 + k × 3 – 22 ÷ 11 + 4 = 28 First, perform the division operations: ⇒ 14 + k × 3 – 2 + 4 = 28 Next, simplify the constants: ⇒ 14 – 2 + 4 = 16 ⇒ 16 + k × 3 = 28 Isolate the term with k: ⇒ k × 3 = 28 – 16 ⇒ k × 3 = 12 Solve for k: ⇒ k = 12 ÷ 3 ⇒ k = 4 ∴ The value of k is 4.

e_en: Given: Total candies = 440 Each student receives = N + 2 candies Formula Used: Total candies = Number of students × Candies per student N × (N + 2) = 440 Calculation: ⇒ N × (N + 2) = 440 ⇒ N² + 2N = 440 ⇒ N² + 2N - 440 = 0 ⇒ (N + 22)(N - 20) = 0 ⇒ N = -22 or N = 20 ⇒ N = 20 (as N cannot be negative) ∴ The correct answer is 20.

q_en: The volume of a cone is 462 cm³, and its height is 14 cm. Find the radius of the base.
e_en: Given: Volume of cone = 462 cm³ Height (h) = 14 cm Formula Used: Volume of cone = (1 ÷ 3) × π × r² × h Calculation: ⇒ 462 = (1 ÷ 3) × π × r² × 14 ⇒ 462 = (14π ÷ 3) × r² ⇒ 462 × 3 = 14π × r² ⇒ 1386 = 14π × r² ⇒ 1386 ÷ 14π = r² ⇒ 99 ÷ π = r² ⇒ r² = 99 ÷ (22 ÷ 7) ⇒ r² = 99 × 7 ÷ 22 ⇒ r² = 693 ÷ 22 ⇒ r² = 31.5 ⇒ r ≈ 5.61 cm ∴ The correct answer is 5.61 cm.

q_en: A regular polygon has twice the number of sides as another regular polygon. The perimeter of the smaller polygon is 84.8 cm and each of its interior angles measures 140°. The side length of the larger polygon is 1.2 times that of the smaller one. What is the measure of angle of the larger polygon?
e_en: Given: Perimeter of smaller polygon = 84.8 cm Each interior angle of smaller polygon = 140° Larger polygon has twice the number of sides Formula Used: Interior angle of regular polygon = [(n − 2) × 180] ÷ n Calculation: ⇒ [(n − 2) × 180] ÷ n = 140 ⇒ 180n − 360 = 140n ⇒ 40n = 360 ⇒ n = 9 ⇒ Number of sides of larger polygon = 2 × 9 ⇒ Number of sides of larger polygon = 18 ⇒ Interior angle of larger polygon = [(18 − 2) × 180] ÷ 18 ⇒ Interior angle = (16 × 180) ÷ 18 ⇒ Interior an…

q_en: The length, breadth, and height of a rectangular parallelepiped are in the ratio 2 : 3 : 4. If the total length of all edges is 108 cm, what is the volume of the parallelepiped?
e_en: Given: Ratio of length : breadth : height = 2 : 3 : 4 Total length of all edges = 108 cm Formula Used: Total length of all edges of cuboid = 4(l + b + h) Volume = l × b × h Calculation: ⇒ Let l = 2x, b = 3x, h = 4x ⇒ 4(l + b + h) = 108 ⇒ 4(2x + 3x + 4x) = 108 ⇒ 4(9x) = 108 ⇒ 36x = 108 ⇒ x = 3 ⇒ l = 2 × 3 = 6 cm ⇒ b = 3 × 3 = 9 cm ⇒ h = 4 × 3 = 12 cm ⇒ Volume = 6 × 9 × 12 ⇒ Volume = 648 cm³ ∴ The correct answer is 648 cm³.
